parsed.post: The last experiment (val_bpb 1.0058) was a regression compared to our best (0.9792). It seems increasing the batch size might have destabilized training or required a different learning rate scaling. Reverting to the best hyperparameters and will try a different direction: lowering MATRIX_LR slightly while keeping high weight decay.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit (74e6aa0) and lowering learning rate to 0.025 to find a more stable regime for DEPTH=8.
